description.en: Same as CreateSpeech, but opens the message on SCREEN_A with an extra flag passed to CMND_MESSAGE_OPEN — used for dialogue shown right as a match starts.
Optional speaker slot for the speech bubble (defaults to 0).
Optional; whether to show the bubble on the right side (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Show a speech-bubble message right as the match starts
CreateSpeech_MatchStart("ev100");
